profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Human Interest (YC ‘15)
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the cloud-native engineering industry.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer (Security Specialization)
positions.description:
Responsible for InfoSec Initiatives
• Instantly log out user if disabled in banking admin console: Flyway Migration to create Postgres blacklist table, Kotlin/JPA to interface with table, custom Spring Boot Filter to check validity of each incoming request.

• Led development effort to scan banking attachments for malicious content: TrendMicro AWS CloudFormation template, S3 for document storage buckets, Lambda to automate scanning and quarantining of malicious files, Simple Email Service (SES) for email notifications once malicious file has been found.

• Led development effort to sanitize banking statement inputs by using ApachePDF to break open the contents of PDF files to look for malicious javascript based on InfoSec best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Leveraged Java, Cassandra Query Language (CQL), Groovy, and SumoLogic in a financial software startup environment focused on delivering a quality and secure Android application.

• Contributed to a Java application which interfaced with a custom REST API and Cassandra table to automatically determine which customers were affected by a service outage. When given the time and location of the outage, the application gathered the phone numbers of affected customers and sent an SMS message (via Twilio API) with recovery details.

• Spearheaded the development of 6 side projects on subject matters ranging from automation of the company’s on- boarding processes to company-specific Slackbots via a custom webhook.

positions.title: Cloud Native Security Co-op
positions.description:
• Created a REST api for a cloud-native bastion microservice running in a Docker container with Python, Flask, Con- nexion, and Swagger.
• Granted the microservice egress capabilities to bypass the corporate subnet and connect to a remote object-store through the use of an outbound proxy.
• Developed access control for a service based on a JWT (Service Access Token).
• Achieved fast delivery through the creation and modification of CI/CD pipelines.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed Java application to convert in-flight information from a surveying drone to Keyhole Markup Language for use with Google Earth, AutoCAD, and Pix4D. The application used an original algorithm and saved over 10 hours per week by replacing a 3rd-party tool which could only convert a fraction of the information at a time.

• Wrote a VBA script to consolidate reports from different financial programs into a single hub that Project Managers used weekly. The script included a notification system which emailed a Project Manager when one of their projects surpassed 80% of budget.

positions.title: Database Administrator/Backend Programmer
positions.description:
• Ensured integrity of database by performing routine checks using PHPMyAdmin.
• Optimized the performance of the database by monitoring the connections requested by each PHP Script.

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
Transitioned from an IT role to a backend developer role which required learning Shell and MySQL on my own time.

Co-developed backend services for an iOS game which amassed over 100,000 downloads. The backend of the application delegated server space for the user’s gameplay by leveraging Shell scripting and Linux performance monitoring tools. The backend team used the Agile System Development Life Cycle process.
